evidence: Looking at a column through the seat (e.g. col 8): row 9 is dark brown top outline, rows 10-11 are medium brown horizontal seat surface, row 12 is a lighter tan front-edge highlight line, row 13 is a darker brown apron/eave shadow, and rows 14-15 are the legs set back with shadow. The backrest on the left also shows a 2-row top surface (rows 2-3) before its vertical side profile. Thus the horizontal seat surface is clearly visible from above (3 rows tall including front edge).

style.evidence: The chair uses 5 distinct brown/tan tones plus cast shadow black on the left/underneath, matching the Beodeul reference wood shading. Outlines are dark brown on the lit/top edges with deep shadow on the left/bottom. Subtle wood grain variation is present on the seat and backrest.
